source_excerpt: Quando um anúncio viola essas regras, ele pode ser suspenso ou removido. Dependendo da gravidade da infração, o vendedor também pode receber Pontos de Penalidade.
notes: Listing-quality violations and prohibited-content rules. 拆分自原 rules/03_listing_violations_duplicates.json（2026-10-28 集成阶段，LV 前缀归 shopee-br-listing-audit）；DUP 部分见 rules/06_duplicate_listings.json。

rules.title: Exaggerated or miraculous health claims
rules.description: Listings removed for exaggerated or miraculous promises. Code [337] carries severity Média and generates a penalty point. The Community Guidelines also state that a listing whose advertising contains 'promessas milagrosas, informações falsas ou enganosas' may be prohibited by regulators.
rules.source_excerpt: [337] Anúncio removido por conter promessas exageradas ou milagrosas. Severidade: Média. Gera ponto de penalidade.

rules.title: Misleading discount or deceptive pricing
rules.description: Listings removed for misleading discounts or deceptive pricing practices. Codes [105] (Desconto enganoso) and [405] (Propaganda Enganosa) both carry severity Baixa and do not generate a penalty point, but the listing is removed.
rules.source_excerpt: [405] Propaganda Enganosa. Severidade: Baixa. Não gera ponto de penalidade.

rules.title: Keyword stuffing in the title
rules.description: Excessive and/or irrelevant keywords in the listing title are removed. Code [506] carries severity Baixa and does not generate a penalty point, but the listing is removed.
rules.source_excerpt: [506] Palavras-chave excessivas e/ou irrelevantes no título do anúncio. Severidade: Baixa. Não gera ponto de penalidade.
rules.notes: 2026-10-27: 修正词数判定 —— 原正则的重复单元 `\w+\b[\s,]*` 要求每词后跟空白/逗号，连字符词（如 Esportivo-running）会中断重复，导致实际词数被低估。改为按 `\w+[-–]?` 连续计词，阈值 15 词不变。

rules.title: Excessive or irrelevant brand names in the title
rules.description: Excessive and/or irrelevant brand names in the listing title are removed. Code [507] carries severity Baixa and does not generate a penalty point.
rules.source_excerpt: [507] Marcas excessivas e/ou irrelevantes no título do anúncio. Severidade: Baixa. Não gera ponto de penalidade.

rules.title: External redirection / off-platform contact details
rules.description: Listings removed for containing information that redirects buyers off Shopee. Code [112] carries severity Média and does not generate a penalty point, but the listing is removed. Off-platform contact details are also listed among prohibited content in the Community Guidelines.
rules.source_excerpt: [112] Anúncio removido por conter informações não permitidas de direcionamento para fora da Shopee. Severidade: Média. Não gera ponto de penalidade.

rules.title: Insufficient, inadequate or irrelevant description
rules.description: Listings removed for insufficient, inadequate or irrelevant product description. Code [605] carries severity Média and generates a penalty point.
rules.source_excerpt: [605] Anúncio removido por conteúdo insuficiente, inadequado ou irrelevante na descrição do produto. Severidade: Média. Gera ponto de penalidade.
rules.notes: 2026-10-27: 修正算子 —— 原写法 `description lt 120` 意为「字符串 < 数字」，评估时抛 TypeError。改为 `length_lt`（字符数比较），语义不变。 | 触发条件语义：description 长度（字符数）小于 120。

rules.title: Low-quality, inappropriate or off-context images
rules.description: Listings removed for low-quality, inappropriate or out-of-context product images. Code [606] carries severity Baixa and does not generate a penalty point.
rules.source_excerpt: [606] Anúncio removido por imagem de baixa qualidade, inapropriada ou fora do contexto do produto anunciado. Severidade: Baixa. Não gera ponto de penalidade.
rules.notes: Only evaluated when the input actually carried image data; a spreadsheet with no image column is a data gap, not a violation. | 2026-10-27: 移除自指的 requires_input —— 原写法`image` 检查与 requires_input 指向同一字段，规则逻辑上永不可满足（字段缺失即被判未评估），等于永不生效。

rules.title: Incorrect product category
rules.description: Listings removed for an incorrect category. Code [613] (Categoria incorreta) and code [612] (Categoria Incorreta - Itens Restritos) both carry severity Baixa and do not generate a penalty point.
rules.source_excerpt: [613] Categoria incorreta. Severidade: Baixa. Não gera ponto de penalidade.
rules.notes: Only evaluated when the input carried a category column. | 2026-10-27: 移除自指的 requires_input —— 原写法`category` 检查与 requires_input 指向同一字段，规则逻辑上永不可满足（字段缺失即被判未评估），等于永不生效。

rules.title: Product sold without the required regulator registration
rules.description: Listings removed for lacking the required registration, homologation or certificate. Codes [503] (sem informação de registro), [504] (ANATEL), [505] (Inmetro) and [307] (GTIN not filled) carry severity Baixa and no penalty point, but they are removed. The policy prohibits products lacking homologation, licence or registration from ANVISA, ANATEL, ANS, INMETRO, ANP and MAPA.
rules.source_excerpt: São proibidos produtos que não tenham a devida homologação, licença e/ou registro das agências nacionais ou órgãos competentes, como: ANVISA, ANATEL, ANS, INMETRO, ANP e MAPA.

rules.title: Product age rating inconsistent with category or title
rules.description: Listings removed when the product's age rating does not match the selected category and/or the listing title. Code [510] carries severity Baixa and does not generate a penalty point.
rules.source_excerpt: [510] A faixa etária do produto não corresponde à categoria selecionada e/ou título do anúncio. Severidade: Baixa. Não gera ponto de penalidade.

rules.title: Inaccurate brand information
rules.description: Listings removed for inaccurate brand information. Code [301] carries severity Baixa and does not generate a penalty point.
rules.source_excerpt: [301] Anúncio removido por imprecisão na marca informada. Severidade: Baixa. Não gera ponto de penalidade.
rules.notes: Only evaluated when the input carried a brand column. | 2026-10-27: 移除自指的 requires_input —— 原写法`brand` 检查与 requires_input 指向同一字段，规则逻辑上永不可满足（字段缺失即被判未评估），等于永不生效。

rules.title: Imprecise dimensions or weight information
rules.description: Listings removed for imprecise information on product dimensions and weight, and for variations carrying imprecise dimension/weight data. Codes [120] (Baixa, no penalty point) and [517] (Extrema, penalty point) cover these.
rules.source_excerpt: [120] Anúncio removido por informações imprecisas sobre dimensões e peso do produto. Severidade: Baixa. Não gera ponto de penalidade.
rules.notes: 2026-10-27: 修复触发正则缺失的右括号 —— 原文无法编译（re.compile 抛错），评估时会中断。匹配语义按原意恢复：外层交替组闭合，各分支显式分组，尾部词边界断言作用于整个组。

rules.title: Excessive dimensions or weight exceeding the shipping limit
rules.description: Listings removed for exceeding the permitted dimensions and/or weights. Code [508] carries severity Baixa (no penalty point); code [509] for the same reason carries severity Alta and does generate a penalty point.
rules.source_excerpt: [509] Anúncio removido por exceder as dimensões e/ou pesos permitidos. Severidade: Alta. Gera ponto de penalidade.
rules.notes: 2026-10-27: 明确语义边界 —— 平台未公开尺寸/重量上限数值（禁止引用未公开数值），本规则只标记「商品声明了完整三维尺寸」这一可判定事实，是否超限由人工复核确认；动作保持 flag_for_review，不阻断。

rules.title: Inappropriate use of variations
rules.description: Listings removed for inappropriate use of variations. Code [309] carries severity Baixa and does not generate a penalty point.
rules.source_excerpt: [309] Anúncio removido por uso inadequado de variações. Severidade: Baixa. Não gera ponto de penalidade.
rules.notes: DRAFT / internal_risk: the trigger as written cannot distinguish an inappropriate use of variations from a legitimate one — it needs the variation-vs-attribute consistency check. Kept as draft so it can never block.

rules.title: Obscene or profane language in listing content
rules.description: Shopee's Community Guidelines prohibit content that contains words considered obscene, coarse, offensive, rude or profane, including coarse references to sexual relations or sexual organs. A listing whose title, description, attributes or brand field carries such language breaches the content rules. Detection is lexical and always requires human confirmation, because the same Portuguese words occur in legitimate merchant copy and in buyer reviews.
rules.source_excerpt: Qualquer conteúdo que contenha palavras consideradas obscenas, carentes de refinamento de gosto, grosseiras, ofensivas, rudes ou profanas, incluindo referências grosseiras à relação sexual ou órgãos sexuais.
rules.notes: 2026-10-28: 词库组 conteudo_ofensivo 触发。仅收录句式组合，不收裸词 —— puta/merda/diabo/idiota 在葡语商品文案与买家评价中有大量合法用法（'vale um diabo'、'idiota do preço'）。命中仅是信号，须人工确认发布者是否确以粗俗语气表述。

rules.title: Sexually suggestive or explicit content in listing material
rules.description: The Community Guidelines prohibit representing sexual content and nudity, whether real, dramatised, illustrated or animated, and prohibit content that depicts or implies sexual acts, that communicates explicit sexual gratification, or that verbally stimulates sexual activity. Listings advertising adult merchandise must stay within the platform's permitted non-explicit presentation; suggestive copy and images are removed.
rules.source_excerpt: Proibimos conteúdo que seja ofensivo, obsceno, ou culturalmente inapropriado ou conteúdo restrito por idade, não adequado para Usuários de todas as idades.
rules.notes: 2026-10-28: 词库组 conteudo_sexual 触发。severity=high 因准则将性与裸露列为独立整节（第 2 节）并覆盖 MEASI（儿童性剥削材料），但决策保持 flag_for_review：文本命中无法证明商品或图片实际露骨，且成人用品在平台有合规类目存在（对比 SBR-RI-002 的 require_evidence 路径）。严禁在报告中输出命中词原文。

rules.title: Promotion, praise or recruitment for extremist or terrorist organisations
rules.description: The Community Guidelines prohibit praising, promoting or helping extremist, criminal or terrorist individuals or organisations, and prohibit content that encourages joining such an organisation or contains their names, symbols, logos, flags, slogans or uniforms. A listing that markets products carrying such organisations' identity, or that recruits for them, breaches the content rules.
rules.source_excerpt: Qualquer conteúdo destinado a elogiar, promover ou ajudar indivíduos ou organizações extremistas, criminosos ou terroristas também não é permitido no Shopee.
rules.notes: 2026-10-28: 词库组 conteudo_extremista 触发。只收「组织/标志物/招募/美化」组合 —— 'igreja'/'religião'/'partido' 单独出现不违规（巴西宗教用品与政党周边为正常商品）。实体标识印在服饰/配件上的情形见 SBR-PI-010（禁售仇恨符号商品）。

rules.title: Misinformation and conspiracy content in listing copy
rules.description: The Community Guidelines prohibit content involving misinformation that incites hatred or prejudice, misinformation associated with emergencies that may cause panic, and medical misinformation that may endanger someone's physical health. Listings whose copy repeats such claims (for example, that a vaccine causes harm, that a certain technology controls people, or that a health product cures a disease) breach the content rules.
rules.source_excerpt: • Qualquer conteúdo envolvendo desinformação que incite ódio ou preconceito
rules.notes: 2026-10-28: 词库组 conteudo_desinformacao 触发。只收成型谣言标签，不收正常疑问句与科普表述。'vacina causa' 等短前缀存在与合法语境（如 'a vacina causa imunidade'）的边界风险，故 human_review_required=true 且 severity=medium，动作不阻断。

rules.title: Nudity or indecent presentation in listing images and copy
rules.description: The Community Guidelines prohibit any content showing total or partial nudity or depicting genitals, breasts or buttocks, whether clothed or not, and prohibit content that appears indecent, morally improper or contrary to social norms. A listing whose images or copy present the product or a model in such a way breaches the content rules.
rules.source_excerpt: • Qualquer conteúdo que mostre nudez (total ou parcial) ou represente genitálias, seios ou nádegas, vestidos ou não.
rules.notes: 2026-10-28: 词库组 vestimenta_indecente 触发。已刻意剔除正常商品词：'saia curta'(短裙)、'biquíni'(泳衣)、'lingerie'(内衣)、'top sem aro'(无钢圈内衣) 均为合法商品不收。本规则只管文案表述层面的裸露宣称，图片层面的裸露判读由图片审核流程处理（image_review 证据）。

rules.title: Hate symbols and racial-supremacy markings on the product itself
rules.description: Carrying hate symbols or racial-supremacy markings on a product is a prohibited-item problem rather than merely a content problem: the Community Guidelines forbid content carrying the names, symbols, logos, flags, slogans or uniforms of extremist organisations, and forbid hate speech that dehumanises people by comparing them to animals, vermin, diseases or inanimate objects, while the platform's prohibited-items policy bars Nazi symbols outright. A garment, accessory or decoration that reproduces such a marking is itself a banned item.
rules.source_excerpt: • Qualquer conteúdo contendo nomes, símbolos, logotipos, bandeiras, slogans, uniformes, retratos, músicas, letras e outros objetos de ou associados a uma organização extremista, criminosa ou terrorista
rules.notes: 2026-10-28: 词库组 simbolo_odio 触发。category=prohibited_item（实体商品带标识 = 禁售商品）而非 listing_violation。severity=critical 因命中对象为极端主义标识本身，但 decision 保持 flag_for_review 而非 block：文本关键词无法证明商品实物印制了该标识（可能只是描述历史/教育用途），须图片人工确认。卐/卍 单字符不合词库最小长度要求，以短语形式（cruz 卐 / 卐 nazi）收录。
